summary: Tıbb-ul Furkan backend + frontend tested. Pytest: 11/12 passed. LLM endpoint /api/profiles/{id}/llm-analysis fails with 500 (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded: 'Max budget: 0.001, current cost: 0.055884'). All other backend APIs (health, diseases, cause-categories, profile CRUD, analysis, re-analyze, disease-matching Şeker→Diyabet, rule-based maternal/paternal scoring, adak_eylem & faiz keyword mapping, MongoDB _id exclusion, 404 edge cases) PASS. Frontend mobile UI verified end-to-end: home loads with title and all testIDs, navigation to onboarding works (1/4 progress, gender selectors, inputs with testIDs), profile detail shows burden distribution bar (Anne/Baba/Kendi %), dominant categories, disease matches with A/B/K side tags, mind map SVG renders with maternal node left (terracotta), paternal node right (slate blue), center user node; tap ancestor node opens detailed modal with diseases/events/vows/sins; disease library lists 50 entries with search input and detail testIDs. No deprecated Expo packages. No React Native red-screens. Only stylistic console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode' (non-blocking).

critical.issue: Returns 500 (ingress shows 502). Root cause from backend log: emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ChatError -> litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.055884, Max budget: 0.001. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap is 0.001 USD which is exhausted. Needs key/budget refresh.

minor.issue: Server raises HTTPException(500) but propagates raw ChatError message containing internal stack info. Consider wrapping in user-friendly Turkish error and returning 503 when LLM provider budget/quota errors occur.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Devam Et' (next-btn) with all fields empty does not display any visible validation/error message. Either silently blocks navigation or no feedback shown. Spec requires 'empty submission shows error'. Needs inline error text per field or toast.
LLM trigger button uses testID 'llm-btn' but spec mentions 'llm-analysis-btn'. Consider standardising naming (minor; not blocking).

integration_issues.flow: Detaylı Analiz → Detaylı Yorumu Başlat (LLM call)
integration_issues.issue: Triggers /api/profiles/{id}/llm-analysis which currently fails due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhaustion. End user will see error in this flow until key budget is refreshed.

issues: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — move resizeMode from StyleSheet to Image component prop.

action_items: CRITICAL: Refresh / increase EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget in /app/backend/.env (current Max budget: 0.001 USD, already exceeded at 0.055884). After refresh, re-run pytest TestProfileFlow::test_llm_analysis.
Add user-facing validation messages on /onboarding/personal when 'Devam Et' is tapped with empty required fields (first_name, last_name, birth_date, gender).

Wrap LLM ChatError in backend (server.py llm_deep_analysis ~line 501) so external clients receive a clean Turkish error and proper status code (e.g. 503 for provider budget/quota issues) instead of raw stack message.
Move <Image> resizeMode from style object to prop to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py llm_deep_analysis lacks try/except around send_message — any provider failure (budget, rate-limit) propagates as 500 and exposes internal error text.
Onboarding personal screen lacks visible validation feedback for required fields; relies on silent prevention which hurts UX.
Disease matching uses substring match (e.g. 'Şeker' matches 'Diyabet (Şeker Hastalığı)') which works, but consider tokenised matching to avoid accidental partial hits in future.

Rule-based paternal score requires that user's diseases overlap with a disease whose causes include the paternal category. Pure paternal signals (e.g. faiz) without matching diseases yield score 0 — design works as intended but may surprise users.

success_rate.backend: 91.7% (11/12 pytest, only LLM endpoint failing due to budget)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all surveyed flows render & navigate correctly; validation message missing on stage 1)

seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete a TEST_Ahmet profile per run (auto-cleanup via DELETE). One pre-existing profile e4d5c75d-cfaa-4aee-9729-94b946da4d2e (Ahmet Test) was reused for UI testing and left intact.

Pre-existing UI profile id: e4d5c75d-cfaa-4aee-9729-94b946da4d2e. LLM endpoint will keep returning 500 until EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is refreshed — re-run test_llm_analysis after refresh. Mind map node testIDs are 'node-{ancestor_id}'; ancestor modal opens on tap and shows diseases/events/unfulfilled_vows/sins as specified.
rca_of_issue: LLM 500: emergentintegrations.LlmChat.send_message → litellm.acompletion raises BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.055884, Max budget: 0.001'. The Emergent LLM key configured in /app/backend/.env has a 0.001 USD daily budget cap which has been exhausted by prior Claude Sonnet 4.6 calls. Mitigation: rotate / top up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget; additionally wrap the call site (server.py ~line 501) with try/except to translate provider errors into a 503 with a friendly Turkish message.
